note: The December 2024 compromise: format.yml runs on pull_request_target and hands two secrets to ultralytics/actions@main, which checked out the fork head and interpolated the branch name in a shell inside the action (invisible from this repository, so no pr_target fact can be proven here); the poisoned cache then reached publish.yml, which publishes to PyPI. From the workflow files the spec gives a High path through the mutable action into the secrets-holding format job, and a path through the mutable PyPI publish action into the publishing job that reaches a Critical; no finding says either action is already bad and both owners are authorized, so each is only not pinned and capped at Medium, as is the Slack action into the publishing job. The cache route itself is closed today: GitHub gives a pull_request_target run read-only access to the default branch's caches unless the job declares cache-mode: write, which format.yml does not, so ISSUE-705 is silent and no cache path exists (issue #533). Each entry into the publishing job is one path, whatever it publishes or deploys. Hand count: three Medium paths 3 x 6 = 18, no other finding, so 100 - 18 = 82: B.
